note: pN is 1-based index into standard COCO-17 order (p1=nose, p2=left_eye, p3=right_eye, p4=left_ear, p5=right_ear, p6=left_shoulder, p7=right_shoulder, p8=left_elbow, p9=right_elbow, p10=left_wrist, p11=right_wrist, p12=left_hip, p13=right_hip, p14=left_knee, p15=right_knee, p16=left_ankle, p17=right_ankle).
